displayName.zh: 希尔克内斯旅行准备度

title.zh: 希尔克内斯官方旅游信息

summary.en: The border with Russia is strictly monitored. Violations are criminal offenses enforced by military border guards.
summary.zh: 与俄罗斯的边界受到严格监控。违规行为属于刑事犯罪，由军事边防警卫执行。

mitigations.en: Do NOT cross the border line (even just a hand or foot) for a photo.
mitigations.zh: 切勿越过边界线（即使只是手或脚）拍照。

mitigations.en: Do NOT throw objects across the border.
mitigations.zh: 切勿向边界对面投掷物体。

mitigations.en: Do NOT photograph military personnel or installations if indicated.
mitigations.zh: 如果标明禁止，切勿拍摄军事人员或设施。

summary.en: Inland Finnmark (Pasvik valley) is one of the coldest places in Norway, often reaching -30°C.
summary.zh: 内陆芬马克（帕斯维克山谷）是挪威最冷的地方之一，气温经常达到 -30°C。

mitigations.en: Cover all skin. Frostbite risk is immediate.
mitigations.zh: 遮盖所有皮肤。冻伤风险是即时的。

items.en: Flight booking to KKN (Note: SAS/Norwegian fly here, often via Oslo/Tromsø)
items.zh: 预订飞往 KKN 的航班（注：SAS/Norwegian 飞往此处，通常经由奥斯陆/特罗姆瑟）

items.en: Transfer from airport (Airport bus corresponds with flight arrivals, otherwise expensive taxi)
items.zh: 机场接送（机场巴士与航班到达时间对应，否则出租车很贵）

items.en: Passport (Must carry valid ID near the border zone)
items.zh: 护照（在边境区域附近必须随身携带有效身份证件）

items.en: Wool base layers (Tour operators provide snow suits, but you need warm underwear)
items.zh: 羊毛打底衣（旅游运营商提供雪地服，但你需要保暖内衣）

items.en: Empty stomach (King Crab safaris provide unlimited crab legs - it is a huge meal)
items.zh: 空腹（帝王蟹之旅提供无限量蟹腿——这是一顿大餐）

message.en: At the Russian border marker (Grense Jakobselv or Skafferhullet): strictly NO crossing. Even touching the marker on the other side is illegal. Fines are heavy (approx 10,000 NOK).
message.zh: 在俄罗斯边界标志处（Grense Jakobselv 或 Skafferhullet）：严禁越界。即使触摸另一侧的标志也是违法的。罚款很重（约 10,000 挪威克朗）。

title.en: Read border behavior rules posted at sites
title.zh: 阅读现场张贴的边境行为规则

message.en: King Crab Safaris are the main attraction. They usually include transport, clothing, and a meal. Book at least 1-2 weeks in advance in winter season.
message.zh: 帝王蟹之旅是主要景点。通常包含交通、服装和餐食。冬季请至少提前 1-2 周预订。
